text: JochenYang DSH Rewind 插件用于撤回已发送的用户消息，让对话回到所选消息之前，并把原文放回输入框。它在 DSH Web 客户端提供消息撤回图标、/rewind 命令和选择器；撤回时可将相关工作区文件恢复到回合前状态，并把被移出的文件内容保存在隔离区。用户可预览撤回计划、选择仅撤回对话，或在设置页查看和清理隔离内容。适合需要修正已发送提示并回退其后续会话与文件更改的 DSH 用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

JochenYang DSH Rewind recalls a sent message and returns its text to the composer. Its web client adds a message action and /rewind command. Users can preview a rewind, restore workspace files, and manage displaced content in Settings. No API key or external service is needed.

JochenYang DSH Rewind 的功能「命令撤回」：使用 /rewind 列出可撤回消息，或指定序号回到该用户消息之前；plan 子命令只预览变更。
JochenYang DSH Rewind 的功能「输入框回填」：撤回后将原消息文字放回输入框，方便修正并重新发送。可从消息操作或命令流程触发。
JochenYang DSH Rewind 的功能「工作区文件恢复」：撤回会尝试依据写入前记录和工作区快照恢复受影响文件，并报告覆盖情况与未恢复项目。
JochenYang DSH Rewind 的功能「隔离区管理」：在设置页按会话查看被移出的文件内容，可逐项或批量清理隔离区。
JochenYang DSH Rewind 仅在 agent 空闲时执行撤回；运行中的回合会被拒绝，以免留下不完整的工具调用序列。（见 src/index.ts:689）

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Introduction：

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Introduction：Message recall for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): cut the
conversation back to before a message you already sent.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Introduction：A sent message cannot be edited or withdrawn. This plugin cuts the model-visible surface back to
before a chosen user message, hides that message and everything after it in the transcript, and puts
the original text back in the composer so you can correct it and send it again. Files the recalled
turns changed are put back byte for byte, and every displaced byte is kept in a quarantine you can
look into and clear. A recall that could not cover everything says so instead of claiming a clean
revert.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · See it：The confirmation dialog before a recall: which files the recall will change, a real before/after diff for
each one, and where the bytes that were in the way end up. Nothing is deleted.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · What it adds：| Surface                          | Where                                                                                                               |
|----------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Per-message recall icon          | hover a user message in the transcript                                                                              |
| `/rewind`                        | bare lists the recallable messages; `/rewind <n>` recalls one; `/rewind plan <n>` previews without doing it; `/rewind conversation <n>` recalls the messages and leaves every file alone (the same choice the confirmation dialog offers) |
| Composer prefill                 | the recalled text returns to the input box, once per recall                                                         |
| **Settings → Recall quarantine** | its own page in Settings: every displaced file, grouped by session, discard per row or per session behind a confirm |

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · What it adds：A recall stops at the most recent compaction. A compaction replaces the history it summarised with one
checkpoint message, so the prompts before it are no longer on the model-visible surface and the list
cannot offer them. `/rewind` says that: the listing, an out-of-range answer, the picker and the
confirmation dialog all name the boundary instead of showing a shorter list without a reason.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · or from the repository, built on install：`peerDependencies` deliberately declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package. The installer compares
every such peer against the running runtime version and refuses the install when it does not match,
which would pin the plugin to one DSH release. This plugin needs nothing installed to run — the
runtime packages below are already present in any DSH profile — so the check is skipped and any
runtime version installs. The tradeoff is deliberate: a DSH release that breaks one of those
interfaces will load the plugin and fail at that call, instead of being refused at install time.

text:
@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Why nothing is lost：Files are never unlinked. The bytes in the way move into
`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-rewind-plugin/quarantine/<session>/<slot>/` — with a `manifest.json` naming
the original path — before the before-image is written back. A file the recalled range created is
moved there rather than deleted.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Why nothing is lost：A recall has to know what the range started from, so the plugin takes one bounded copy of the
workspace before a turn's first writing tool and stores it content-addressed under
`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-rewind-plugin/{trees,blobs}`. That copy is what makes a file a shell command
rewrote restorable: the `write` / `edit` waterfalls still supply the exact before-image for the tools
they see, and where the snapshot covered a path its bytes are the ones that go back.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · For other plugins：A recall changes the transcript and the working tree. A plugin that mirrored a turn — a board, an
archive, a task list — has to put its own state back too, so the host half publishes the
`dsh-rewind-participants` service. Declare it in your `inject`, call
`register({ id, reconcileAfterRewind })`, and every recall runs your participant after the surface
write, in registration order. A participant that throws or misses its 30-second deadline is logged and
skipped — it cannot fail the recall — and the command collects each participant's result under its id
(the file revert's tally is the one that rides the result). The file revert is itself the first
participant, so this is the path the plugin's own feature already uses.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · What it needs at runtime：Resolved from the profile, never bundled:

`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`,
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection`, `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`, `zod`.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Operational notes：- **One writer per session.** DSH takes a cross-process exclusive write lock per session, held for
  the life of a write handle. Two DSH processes that share `$DSH_HOME` therefore cannot both write
  the same session: the second one's command execution is refused with `session/writer-held`, and a
  recall reports that the request never reached the kernel. Reading a session from a second instance
  is fine and different sessions never conflict — close it in the other window, or work in another
  session.
- A recall needs an idle agent. A running turn is refused rather than raced, because cutting
  mid-turn would leave that turn's tool results without their call.

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Known limits：- A file changed by a tool this plugin cannot observe — a shell command, a script the model ran, a
  renderer — is covered by the workspace snapshot rather than by the write waterfalls. The snapshot is
  bounded (file count, total bytes, per-file bytes, a deadline, and the tool call's abort signal), so
  a very large tree, an unreadable file, a symlink or a timed-out walk can leave a path out. Every
  recall reports a `coverage` verdict — `full`, `partial` or `none` — with the reason and the writing
  tools involved, so a gap is visible instead of silent.
- Dependency, VCS and cache directories (`node_modules`, `.git`, …) are outside coverage on purpose,
  so a recall that ran `npm install` does not report the dependency tree. Build output such as `dist/`
  IS walked.
- `size` + `mtime` unchanged counts as unchanged. A writer that restores an old mtime at an unchanged
  size is missed — the same bargain every sync tool makes.
- The placeholder is an empty `user/message`. The DeepSeek provider's request path drops an empty
  user message, so it contributes no model-facing turn there; a provider that does not drop empty
  user conte

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · Introduction：给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的消息撤回：把会话退回到某条
已发送消息之前。

已发送的消息改不了也收不回。这个插件把模型可见的对话表面裁到某条用户消息之前：这条消息及其之后的
内容退出模型上下文、从对话界面隐藏，原文回到输入框，可以改完重发。被撤回的那些回合改动过的文件会
逐字节恢复原样，而每一个被移走的字节都留在隔离区里，可以查看、可以清空。如果这次撤回没能覆盖全部
改动，结果会如实说明，而不是谎称已经完整还原。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 效果：撤回前的确认框：这次撤回会改动哪些文件、每个文件的真实前后差异，以及挡路的那些字节最后去了哪里。
不会删除任何东西。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 它带来什么：| 位置                  | 说明                                                                             |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 每条消息上的撤回图标  | 把鼠标停在对话里的一条用户消息上                                                 |
| `/rewind`             | 留空列出可撤回的消息；`/rewind <n>` 撤回第 n 条；`/rewind plan <n>` 只看预览不动手；`/rewind conversation <n>` 只撤回消息、文件保持不动（确认框里也提供同样的选择） |
| 输入框回填            | 被撤回消息的原文回到输入框，一次撤回只回填一次                                    |
| **设置 → 撤回隔离区** | 设置里独立的一页：按会话分组列出每个被移走的文件，逐条或整段清空，清空前有一次确认  |

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 它带来什么：隔离区这一页注册在 `settings.section`——设置外壳自己留给功能插件的座位，所以它和内置的「通用 / 模型 /
插件」并列。没有设置外壳的 profile 只是少这一页，其余功能不受影响。

撤回会在最近一次压缩处停下：压缩把被总结的历史换成一条 checkpoint 消息，它之前的提示不再是模型可见
表面上的节点，列表也就无法提供它们。`/rewind` 会把这件事说出来：列表、越界回答、选择器和确认框都会
点名这条压缩边界，而不是只给一个更短的列表。

text:
@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 为什么不会丢东西：会话日志只追加，它始终是唯一的事实来源。一次撤回只追加一条带
`surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }` 的事件，所以日志里每个事件都还在；不理会 surface op
的读取方看到的仍是完整对话。

文件从不被删除。挡路的那些字节先被移进
`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-rewind-plugin/quarantine/<会话>/<槽位>/`（连同写明原路径的 `manifest.json`），
然后才写回改动前的版本。被撤回区间新建出来的文件也是移进去，而不是删掉。

撤回需要知道这个区间的起点长什么样，所以插件会在一个回合里第一个「可能写入」的工具之前，给工作区
拍一份有上限的副本，按内容寻址存到 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-rewind-plugin/{trees,blobs}`。命令行命令
改写过的文件之所以能还原，靠的就是这份副本：`write` / `edit` 这两条瀑布仍然提供它们能看到的精确改动前
镜像，而快照覆盖到的路径以快照的字节为准。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 给其他插件：撤回会改动会话表面与工作区。任何镜像过某个回合的插件——看板、归档、任务清单——也得把自己的状态收回来，
所以宿主这一半发布了 `dsh-rewind-participants` 服务。在自己的 `inject` 里声明它，调用
`register({ id, reconcileAfterRewind })`，之后每次撤回都会在写入会话表面之后按注册顺序运行你的参与者。
抛错或超过 30 秒截止时间的参与者会被记进日志并跳过，不会让撤回失败；命令按 id 收集每个参与者的结果
（随结果返回的是文件还原的那份报告）。文件还原本身就是第一个参与者，这条接缝就是插件自己正在走的路。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 运行时需要什么：从 profile 里解析，不打包进产物：

`@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`、
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`、`zod`。

浏览器半边只需要 `react`、`react/jsx-runtime`、`react-dom/client` 与
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，这四者由外壳自己的模块表提供。它们不写进
`dsh.client.external`，因为外壳本来就能回答。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 使用注意：- **一个会话同时只有一个写入者。** DSH 对每个会话持有一把跨进程独占写锁，直到写句柄关闭才释放。
  因此共用同一个 `$DSH_HOME` 的两个 DSH 进程无法同时写同一个会话：后者的命令执行会被
  `session/writer-held` 拒绝，撤回则会报「请求没能送到内核」。第二个实例**读**同一个会话没问题，
  不同会话之间也从不冲突——把那个会话在另一个窗口里关掉，或者换一个会话继续。
- 撤回需要 agent 处于空闲。正在跑的回合会被直接拒绝而不是去抢，因为从回合中间裁剪会让该回合后面的
  工具结果失去对应的调用。

@jochenyang/dsh-rewind-plugin README · 已知限制：- 由本插件观察不到其写入的工具改动的文件——命令行命令、模型跑的脚本、渲染器——由工作区快照负责，
  而不是那两条写入瀑布。快照是有上限的（文件数、总字节、单文件字节、截止时间，以及工具调用的 abort
  signal），所以特别大的目录树、读不了的文件、符号链接或超时的遍历都可能留下没覆盖到的路径。每次撤回
  都会报告覆盖度——`full`、`partial` 或 `none`——连同原因和涉及的写入工具，缺口是看得见的，而不是静默的。
- 依赖、版本控制与缓存目录（`node_modules`、`.git` 等）故意不在覆盖范围内，所以跑过 `npm install` 的
  撤回不会报告依赖树；而 `dist/` 这类构建产物是会被遍历的。
- `size` + `mtime` 都没变就当作没变。一个把旧 mtime 恢复回来、大小又刚好相同的写入者会被漏掉——这是
  所有同步工具都要做的取舍。
- 占位符是一条内容为空的 `user/message`。DeepSeek 的请求构造会丢掉空的用户消息，所以它在那边不产生
  面向模型的回合；换成不丢空用户内容的 provider，一次撤回会多出一条空的用户消息。
